how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online for KRCL Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Visit the official KRCL website, www.konkanrailway.com, once the application link goes live (tentatively last week of August 2026).
Register your name on the portal; a Registration Number will be generated and sent via registered email and mobile number, along with a password and application link.
Activate the link to access the application form and fill in personal, educational, and category details, carefully selecting your post-wise preference (this cannot be changed once submitted).
Pay the prescribed examination fee online for each CBT Examination Group selected, using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI.
Upload the required scanned documents - photograph, signature, and category certificates (if applicable).
Review all entries carefully, then submit the application before the closing date.
Keep a printed copy of the submitted online application for future reference - do not send it to KRCL by post.
Candidates are advised to apply only through the official KRCL website and to be cautious of fake websites and job racketeers, as KRCL has not appointed any agents or coaching centres on its behalf.
important_instructions: Candidates can apply for one or more posts in a single application, in order of preference; once exercised, post preference is final and cannot be changed. KRCL will allot only one post to a selected candidate, based on preference, merit, vacancy position, and qualifying the selection stages - no request for a lower-preference post will be entertained after allotment. Serving Government/PSU employees may apply directly but must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of DV, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. Selected candidates can be posted anywhere within KRCL's area of operation, including project sites; KRCL employees are not eligible for transfer to other Zonal Railways. Candidates must ensure their mobile number and email ID are active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be via SMS and email only. Any candidate found using unfair means, impersonation, or furnishing false information will be disqualified and debarred from future KRCL examinations, and is liable for legal action. KRCL reserves the right to change the number of vacancies, cancel the recruitment process in part or full, and reject applications without assigning reasons.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility to Apply
content_sections.text: KRCL Recruitment 2026 is open to the following categories of candidates: Land Loser Candidates: Candidates whose land was acquired for construction of the Konkan Railway Line between Roha (Maharashtra) and Thokur (Karnataka), irrespective of the percentage of land lost. The land loser and/or their spouse, son, daughter, grandson, or granddaughter are eligible under the landloser quota. Employment Exchange Registered Candidates: Domiciles of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka with valid employment exchange cards registered along the Konkan Railway route (Raigad, Sindhudurg, and Ratnagiri districts of Maharashtra; Goa State; Uttara Kannada, Udupi, and Dakshina Kannada/South Kannada districts of Karnataka). Other Domicile Candidates: Candidates domiciled in the States of Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka (not covered above). KRCL Employees: Serving KRCL employees who have completed at least 3 years of regular service. Note: Recruitment in the erstwhile Group-D post - Track Maintainer - is limited to eligible Land Loser candidates only. Candidates securing the minimum qualifying marks are given preference for recruitment in the following order: Land Loser candidates (first preference) Candidates registered in Employment Exchanges along the KR route (second preference) Candidates domiciled in Maharashtra, Goa, or Karnataka, and KRCL employees (third preference) Candidates must declare their status (Land Loser/Employment Exchange/Domicile) at the time of application; this choice is final. The second and third panels are operated only after exhausting the panel of eligible land losers.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Recruitment 2026 Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: This notification provides Vertical Reservation for SC, ST, OBC-NCL, and EWS, and Horizontal Reservation for Ex-Servicemen (Ex.SM) and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). EWS Reservation: Candidates not covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL reservation, whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8 lakh and who do not own specified categories of land/property, can claim EWS reservation with a valid Income & Asset Certificate. Note: EBC and EWS are different categories - EBC candidates get fee concession only, not job reservation. Horizontal Reservation: Ex-Servicemen and PwBD reservations are included within the post-wise vacancies shown above, irrespective of social community. Ex.SM and PwBD candidates can also apply against unreserved vacancies of posts not exclusively earmarked for them (PwBD candidates only where the post is indicated as suitable for their disability), and are eligible for age relaxation and fee exemption. PwBD Categories: VI (Visually Impaired: Blind/Low Vision), HI (Hearing Impaired: Deaf/Hard of Hearing), LD (Locomotor Disability: One Arm/One Leg/One Arm-Leg/Dwarfism) - subject to a minimum of 40% disability. One Commercial Supervisor post is reserved for PwBD candidates. EWS, SC, ST, and OBC-NCL candidates who qualify without relaxed standards will not be adjusted against reserved vacancies and will be considered under UR.

content_sections.heading: KRCL Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern (CBT)
content_sections.text: The recruitment process varies by post group: Section Controller, Station Master, Assistant Loco Pilot: CBT → Computer-Based/OMR-based Aptitude Test → Document Verification (DV) → Medical Examination. Merit is prepared with 70% weightage to CBT marks and 30% to Aptitude Test marks. Senior Section Engineer (Mechanical/S&T), Junior Engineer (Civil/Mechanical), Goods Train Manager, Commercial Supervisor, Technician-III (Mechanical), ESTM-III: CBT → Document Verification → Medical Examination. Track Maintainer: CBT → Document Verification → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Medical Examination. The CBT is of screening nature with negative marking - one mark is deducted for each wrong answer. Questions are set in five languages: English, Hindi, Marathi, Konkani, and Kannada (the Aptitude Test for SCOR/SM/ALP is in English and Hindi only). The full unit-wise technical syllabus for each post - covering subjects such as Engineering Mechanics, Strength of Materials, Building Materials & Construction, Surveying, Thermal Engineering, Basic Electricity/Electronics, and related topics - is detailed separately in the official notification (Section 14.7 to 14.14) and should be reviewed in full by candidates preparing for the CBT. These are minimum qualifying marks; the actual cutoff may be higher depending on the number of candidates clearing the minimum. Qualifying marks are relaxed by 2% for PwBD candidates.
